about_the_game:
Summary

A brutal medieval turn-based RPG where scars, survival, and choices define your story. Face bloody duels, shifting factions, and moral dilemmas in a dying world where every decision leaves a mark.

Core Concept

Scarred Steel is a story-rich, tactical RPG with grounded medieval combat and a heavy focus on consequences. Inspired by Heads Will Roll and classic dark RPGs, it blends brutal 1v1 duels, strategic preparation, and narrative choice into a journey of survival and betrayal.

Key Features

⚔ Tactical Duels With Weight
Combat is immediate and lethal. Stamina, weapon reach, and balance all matter. Every duel feels like a fight for your life.

🩸 Scars That Shape Your Character
No magical healing here. Every wound, scar, and limitation follows you forward, influencing how you fight, rest, and prepare.

🏰 A Living, Reactive World
Your ethos, mercy, cruelty, honor, deceit, changes how factions, NPCs, and storylines unfold. Friends can become rivals, allies can betray, and towns will remember.

📜 Branching, Replayable Narratives
Each run unfolds differently through dynamic encounters, rival NPCs, and moral choices. Scarred Steel is built for replayability,  no two journeys are the same.

⚖ A Town Hub Between Battles
Rest at the inn, train your body, gamble in the tavern, buy from smiths, or enter the arena. Every preparation step shapes how far you’ll get.

🌑 A Gritty Medieval World
Plague, betrayal, and survival set the tone. Scarred Steel pulls no punches, this is a grounded, harsh medieval world where power and morality collide.

🗒️Note From Ethan The Developer

All the game's code, images and videos were made all with AI, AKA I've built this game without knowing how to code. If you like the game or have interest in my journey, you can check out my YouTube to see how I built the game!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes graphic medieval violence, blood, and injury. Players will experience intense combat, death, and survival scenarios in a dark, plague-ridden world.

Mature themes include:

- Realistic injury and blood effects in combat
- Descriptions of disease, suffering, and societal collapse
- Grim tone and survivalist narrative elements

There is no sexual content, no drug use, no self-harm, and no depictions of sexual assault.

These mature elements appear in both gameplay and narrative sequences from early in the game and continue throughout.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Requires a keyboard and mouse
